FICT 2027: International Conference on Fictional Computing

Accepted papers will be published by IEEE in the FICT Proceedings series.

The conference is technically co-sponsored by the IEEE Computer Society.

Topics include machine learning, computer vision and natural language processing.

Registration fee: USD 450 for regular authors.

Proceedings will be submitted for indexing in Scopus and DBLP.

Questions? Write to program-chairs@fict2027.example.org.
